messages:
maya: Heads-up 1: we need a crisp launch gate for the new Optimize toolkit pilot focused on batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. RetailX and FinNova pushed requests that expand scope. Quick thoughts?
liam: Short answer: gate. Long answer: define measurable gates for quality, latency and cost.
jordan: Agreed. Suggest 3-tier gates: BLOCK (auto rollback on quality), WARNING (trend alert), INFO (observability only).
maya: RetailX specifically wants automatic fallback to FP16 if int8 causes >2% drop on their commerce eval. Can we support per-customer thresholds?
sarah: We can, but we need per-route evalsets. Do we have their top prompt templates?
maya: RetailX will provide them, FinNova might require stricter SLOs (fraud checks).
liam: Ops note: fallback increases cost ~15-20% for some configs. Need econ signoff or a budget cap.
jordan: For pilot launch checklist propose: 
- per-route evals wired to nightly jobs
- alerting policy mapped to auto/notify actions
- canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with manual hold points
- documented cost delta and approval path
- post-rollout daily evals scheduled
maya: Include acceptance criteria: RetailX signoff for their top-10 prompts. Also require SRE and Product to agree on rollback thresholds.
optimize-bot: nightly-eval finished: model=redwood-ggml-v2 int8 vs fp16: RetailX-cart RougeDelta=1.9% (under 2% threshold).
sarah: Nice. But we should also define deterministic repro steps when alert fires (fixed seeds, reduce non-determinism). Add to runbook.
liam: I'll draft the runbook + CLI play commands. Example commands to include: 
```
# compare evals
python infra/eval/compare.py --route retailx-cart --baseline fp16 --variant int8
# force fallback
redwoodctl rollout fallback --route retailx-cart --target fp16
```
jordan: Also add a soft-throttle option: keep quant but reduce max tokens or window size to hit latency SLOs without full fallback. Middle ground for cost/quality.
maya: Love the soft-throttle idea 1. Add as an option in the playbook.
sarah: I'll confirm RetailX top-10 prompts during Thu onboarding call.
maya: Owners: liam=runbook+fallback impl (due Wed EOD), jordan=per-route eval spec + sample evalset (due Fri), sarah=customer prompts + signoff flow. I'll collate checklist after Thu call.
liam: Ack. I'll also capture estimated cost delta per model variant for product review.
optimize-bot: canary pipeline created: https://ci.internal/runs/993 tag=v0.1-optimize-pilot
maya: Thanks all 44d I'll post consolidated checklist + initial runbook after the call.
